items.title: Claude Code AI agent update: - Fixed turns ending in "Prompt is too long" after repeated auto-compaction failures when one more compaction at the context limit
items.summary: - Fixed turns ending in "Prompt is too long" after repeated auto-compaction failures when one more compaction at the context limit could have kept them going - Fixed freezes and runaway memory use in most cases while a hook prints output without end - Fixed a freeze and context overflow when a hook blocks or fails during a turn, or after `/compact`, with a very large log; text over about 50,000 ch
items.relevance: 這個議題涉及 Crew Pocket、Crew Deck 的實作方向。可先評估現有做法，再決定是否安排小型實驗。
actions: 閱讀原文，確認它解決的問題、實驗方法及適用限制
檢查相關功能現有做法，找出可比較的差異
用小型 PoC 驗證成功率、品質、延遲和實際成本
items.body: - Fixed turns ending in "Prompt is too long" after repeated auto-compaction failures when one more compaction at the context limit could have kept them going - Fixed freezes and runaway memory use in most cases while a hook prints output without end - Fixed a freeze and context overflow when a hook blocks or fails during a turn, or after `/compact`, with a very large log; text over about 50,000 characters is now shortened - Fixed SSE MCP servers hanging or refusing every tool call after their event stream was cut and came back on a new endpoint or not at all, until reconnected by hand
